prompt: After saving, briefly show a small message box in the corner of the screen letting the user know it worked, with a way to dismiss it.

samples.response:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>Save with notification toast</title>
  </head>
  <body>
    <bl-notification id="toasts"></bl-notification>

    <bl-button id="save-btn" variant="primary">Save</bl-button>

    <script>
      const toasts = document.getElementById('toasts');
      const saveBtn = document.getElementById('save-btn');

      saveBtn.addEventListener('bl-click', () => {
        // Blaze: push a toast for this corner-stacked notification container.
        // It auto-dismisses after `duration` seconds and has a close button.
        toasts.addNotification({
          caption: 'Saved',
          description: 'Your changes have been saved successfully.',
          icon: true,
          variant: 'success',
          duration: 5,
        });
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

<bl-button id="save" variant="primary">Save</bl-button>
<bl-notification id="toasts"></bl-notification>
<script>
  const save = document.getElementById("save");
  const toasts = document.getElementById("toasts");

  save.addEventListener("bl-click", () => {
    toasts.addNotification({
      description: "Changes saved successfully.",
      variant: "success",
      duration: 3,
    });
  });
</script>

<bl-button id="save" variant="primary">Save</bl-button>
<bl-notification id="notif" no-animation duration="7"></bl-notification>

<script type="module">
  const notif = document.getElementById('notif');
  const save = document.getElementById('save');

  function onSaved() {
    notif.addNotification({
      caption: 'Saved',
      description: 'Your changes were saved successfully.',
      variant: 'success',
      icon: true,
      duration: 7
    });
  }

  save.addEventListener('bl-click', () => {
    // Simulate a save then surface the success toaster in the corner.
    onSaved();
  });
</script>
